caption: The drawing features two representations of the same long-sleeved, floor-length dress: one in color on the right and one as a pencil sketch on the left. The colored dress is predominantly red with black lace trim along the neckline, cuffs, and front opening. It is patterned with small, evenly distributed black or dark dots and features a large, peach or coral-colored bow at the neck. The lace along the cuffs and front is rendered with detailed frills. The pencil sketch on the left shows the back of the dress, with visible seam lines, pleating, and the same lace trim at the cuffs and collar, but without color or pattern detail. Both depictions emphasize the shape and drape of the garment. The background of the image is a plain, off-white or light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Dress
